//G101: G101 (hardcoded credentials) flags the sqlc-GENERATED query const `getMerchantByAPIKeyHash` in internal/repository/merchant.sql.go: the identifier contains the substring `apiKey` and the value is a SQL string, but it holds NO secret — it is a parameterized ($1) query selecting the `api_key_hash` COLUMN. The generated file carries `// Code generated by sqlc. DO NOT EDIT.`, so an inline // #nosec would be clobbered on `sqlc generate`. We therefore narrow G101's variable-name pattern to identifiers that actually carry secret VALUES (password/secret/token/private_key/bearer), which no longer matches the generated query name. This does not disable G101 and does not blanket-suppress any file.
